headline: Magnitude 6.7 Earthquake Strikes The Andes Mountains In Peru
metaDescription: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Andes region in Peru, with tremors felt as far as Lima. Authorities have reported no injuries following the event.
aiSummaryBullets: A 6.7 magnitude earthquake hit the Andes region in Peru on Friday evening.
Tremors were felt in the capital city of Lima, causing residents to evacuate homes.
Initial reports from authorities indicate that there are no casualties or injuries.
aiContextParagraph: On the evening of Friday, November 20, 2026, a significant earthquake occurred in the Andean region of Peru. Sources provide varying details regarding the seismic event; the United States Geological Survey recorded the magnitude at 6.9 with a depth of 142 kilometers, while other reporting indicates a magnitude of 6.7 at a depth of 108 kilometers. The epicenter was identified 34 kilometers north of Junín. The seismic activity was noted by residents in the capital, Lima, prompting individuals to exit their residences as a safety precaution. Currently, official assessments suggest that no casualties or injuries have been sustained due to the tremor. International news outlets are monitoring the situation as local geological agencies continue to analyze the impact of the activity across the affected mountainous terrain and surrounding urban centers.
